summary: The IDF conducted multiple targeted strikes across the Gaza Strip, eliminating several Hamas operatives including a Nukhba Force company commander and a sniper in northern Gaza, two Nukhba operatives in Khan Yunis, and another operative in Deir al-Balah, all amid reported ceasefire violations. The IDF is reportedly considering redeploying forces from Lebanon and Gaza to Judea and Samaria. A significant threat against Yair Netanyahu prompted his immediate evacuation from the United States.
key_points: IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba Force company commander Hani Abd al-Hai Fakhri Mazloum and sniper Hassan Zidan Hassan Deiri in northern Gaza Strip for advancing attacks and weapons trafficking (Source: New_security8200/203484).

IDF eliminated two Nukhba operatives Yasser Abu al-Hir and Muhammad al-Adin in Khan Yunis, southern Gaza Strip, for advancing attacks and restoring Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire (Source: New_security8200/203491).
IDF eliminated Hamas operative Hassam Osama Hussein Nasir in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip, using precise munitions and aerial surveillance to minimize civilian harm (Source: idf_telegram/25015).
IDF is considering transferring forces from Lebanon and Gaza to Judea and Samaria to reinforce operations there based on operational needs (Source: pkpoi/143772).
Shin Bet assessed a significant threat against Yair Netanyahu during his stay in the US, leading to his immediate evacuation (Source: pkpoi/143765).
IDF struck underground infrastructures in Ali Tower ridge; some terrorists escaped but the siege was maintained on most, with some dying in tunnels (Source: inon_yttach/9976).

Satellite imagery confirmed a maritime corridor behind Musandam island, Oman, 488 meters wide and 29 meters deep, operational for 10 days allowing oil tankers to pass safely (Source: mamlekate/104267).
Hamas commander attacked while riding motorcycle in Dir al-Balgh (Source: lelotsenzura/94261).

iran: Iran's Navy Commander, Rear Admiral Shahram Irani, stated that the enemy has seriously miscalculated the resolve of the Iranian people and armed forces, and that the Navy will continue its mission with greater determination, sparing no effort to defend Iran (Source: presstv/204735).

Satellite imagery confirmed a maritime corridor behind Musandam island, Oman, 488 meters wide and 29 meters deep, operational for 10 days, enabling oil tankers to pass safely away from the sight and fire of the Islamic Republic (Source: mamlekate/104267).

Iranian Navy Commander stated that the enemy would be gravely mistaken if it believes that the martyrdom of some Iranian citizens and Navy personnel would bring the force to a halt (Source: SharghDaily/180798).

The Islamic Republic's Navy was described as remaining active and steadfast, committed to carrying out its mission with strength to ensure and safeguard the security of the Iranian people (Source: presstv/204735).
Reports indicate smuggling of Iranian products to Afghanistan and Iraq, with proceeds going to dollars, though specific quantities and actors were not detailed (Source: kianmeli1/91216).

sections.threat_assessment: Hamas continues to pose an active threat despite the ceasefire, with multiple operatives advancing attacks on IDF forces and Israeli civilians and attempting to restore organizational capabilities in northern Gaza, southern Gaza, and central Gaza. The IDF has systematically struck Hamas military wing operatives including Nukhba Force commanders and snipers, indicating sustained underground resistance. A significant threat was also assessed against Israeli figure Yair Netanyahu during his time in the United States, prompting immediate evacuation. The IDF maintains forces deployed in the south in accordance with the ceasefire agreement while preparing for potential force redeployment to Judea and Samaria.
sections.regional_response: Iran's Navy Commander stated that the enemy has miscalculated Iranian resolve and that the Navy will continue its mission with greater determination, drawing strength from the blood of its martyrs. The US is reportedly considering but withholding secondary sanctions on China for Iranian oil purchases, with former national security officials indicating Washington hopes to avoid this step. A maritime corridor behind Musandam island, Oman, 488 meters wide and 29 meters deep, has been operational for 10 days with US military landing craft, facilitating safe oil tanker passage away from Iranian reach. The IDF is reportedly considering redeploying forces from Lebanon and Gaza to Judea and Samaria based on operational needs.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple IDF strikes across the Gaza Strip in Deir al-Balah, Khan Yunis, and northern Gaza have eliminated several Hamas operatives including Nukhba Force company commander Hani Abd al-Hai Fakhri Mazloum, sniper Hassan Zidan Hassan Deiri, operatives Yasser Abu al-Hir and Muhammad al-Adin, and Hassam Osama Hussein Nasir, all cited for advancing attacks and violating the ceasefire. The IDF employed precise munitions and aerial surveillance to minimize civilian harm in these strikes. Satellite imagery has confirmed a 488-meter-wide, 29-meter-deep maritime corridor behind Musandam island, Oman, operational for 10 days with advanced US landing craft enabling oil tankers to bypass Iranian threat. The IDF is evaluating force redeployment from Lebanon and Gaza to Judea and Samaria, while Shin Bet assessed a significant threat against Yair Netanyahu requiring immediate evacuation from the US.
